H: On the original #3807 seeds/data, changing only the rank-4 online minibatch index stream from seed+35 to shared seed+31 rescues held-out B accuracy; the RNG stream is a candidate explanation, not an asserted cause.

T.sameDataAndTask: Original #3807 CUDA formal runner data and labels: CPU-seeded input tensors copied to CUDA; CUDA base training; 8 features, hidden 16 tanh, 4 classes.
T.base: 512 rows, 400 AdamW steps, LR .025, generator seed+10.
T.online: Rank 4, AdamW LR .04, 16 one-at-a-time feedback rows in seed+20 order, 8 updates/arrival, batch size 32, total 128 steps.
T.pairing: Tensor-identical full adapter initialization per seed; reset each arm's CPU generator for its one fixed stream; balanced arm order 3451 L>S, 3452 S>L, 3453 L>S, 3454 S>L, 3455 L>S.
T.cudaParity: Follow frozen #3807 CUDA runner device and RNG behavior exactly for data generation, base training, and rank-4 adapter initialization. The sole intervention is the rank-4 online minibatch index generator seed: seed+35 versus seed+31.
T.curves: Retain all 4096 heldout B predictions after every arrival 1..16 for both arms, final row predictions, per-arrival timings, setup timings, route controls, snapshot and rollback state.

D.pass: PASS_SAMPLER_SEED_EXPLAINS_COLLAPSE_SCOPED only if legacy final mean <= .10, shared arm >= .90 on every seed, paired mean gain >= .50, p95 <= 60 ms, and all row-level, route, snapshot, base-integrity, provenance and independent audit checks pass.
D.hold: HOLD_LEGACY_COLLAPSE_NOT_REPRODUCED if legacy final mean > .10; make no causal attribution even if shared arm is strong.
D.fail: FAIL_SAMPLER_SEED_NOT_SUFFICIENT if legacy collapse reproduces but rescue criteria fail; FAIL_ROUTE_OR_STATE_INTEGRITY on integrity violation; typed STOP/HOLD on ambiguity.

C.execution: Local host CUDA per issue; no container claim. Docker check is read-only.

U: Five synthetic seeds in one task family only. Does not establish general online adaptation, explain all between-study differences, prove real task quality, authorize runtime updates, or establish production safety/latency.
